metadata.question: Does the NDVI in northern Afghanistan decrease during June-August 2018 compared to the June-August average of 2000-2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1) for long-term comparison (2000-2018) - Two periods: June-August 2018 vs June-August 2000-2013 average - Location: Northern Afghanistan (approximate bounding box) 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS quality flags should be used to mask poor quality pixels - Focus on valid NDVI values 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for both periods - Valid Zero: NDVI can be legitimately low (0.0-0.3) in arid regions - C1: If no images in either period - C2: If valid pixel count is 0 after processing - C3: If NDVI values are None/NaN or out of range (-1 to 1) - A: If 2018 NDVI < baseline average (decrease) - B: If 2018 NDVI >= baseline average (no decrease) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define northern Afghanistan region const northAfghan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[60.5, 35.5], [74.9, 35.5], [74.9, 38.5], [60.5, 38.5], [60.5, 35.5]] ]); // 2. Load MODIS NDVI collection const modisNDVI = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .select('NDVI'); // 3. Baseline period: June-August 2000-2013 const baseline = modisNDVI .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2013, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 8, 'month')); const baselineSize = baseline.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline images (2000-2013, Jun-Aug): ${baselineSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0) { console.log('No baseline data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Target period: June-August 2018 const target = modisNDVI .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2018, 2018, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 8, 'month')); const targetSize = target.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target images (2018, Jun-Aug): ${targetSize}`); if (targetSize === 0) { console.log('No 2018 data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean NDVI (scale factor 0.0001) const baselineMean = baseline.mean().multiply(0.0001); const targetMean = target.mean().multiply(0.0001); // 6. Check pixel counts const baselineCount = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northAfghan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const targetCount = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northAfghan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${targetCount}`); if (baselineCount === 0 || targetCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Calculate regional mean NDVI const baselineNDVI = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northAfghan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const targetNDVI = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northAfghan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline NDVI (2000-2013): ${baselineNDVI !== null ? baselineNDVI.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Target NDVI (2018): ${targetNDVI !== null ? targetNDVI.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); // 8. Validation and final answer if (baselineNDVI === null || targetNDVI === null || isNaN(baselineNDVI) || isNaN(targetNDVI) || baselineNDVI < -1 || baselineNDVI > 1 || targetNDVI < -1 || targetNDVI > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const change = targetNDVI - baselineNDVI; console.log(`NDVI change: ${change.toFixed(4)}`); if (targetNDVI < baselineNDVI) { console.log('NDVI decreased in 2018.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('NDVI did not decrease in 2018.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
